reason: Barter offers already land in my DMs and I'm on Influish applying to campaigns, so I don't need to pay for a pass. I might try the free first counted collab with a café I already work with, but I'm not paying ₹499 until I see that a count actually gets me cash instead of a free meal.
objection: Will a café owner actually bother making customers show my coupon at the counter, and will the next business even care about a 'customers I brought' number from an app nobody's heard of yet?
would_change_my_mind: If my free counted collab showed real numbers and a business paid me cash because of that record, I'd buy the pass right away.
